title: 第十六章 问问第十七章 谁是魔教
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
那青面红眼的人，说话时距离这孙家大哥极近。
喷吐的气息，落在脸上，只觉得一阵恶臭。
两眼一翻，剧烈的惊恐之下，也管不住裤裆里那位，哗哗的就尿了一裤子。
抓着他的那人，顿时一脸嫌弃。
左手摁在他的后脑勺上，往门框边那石头垒砌的墙头一撞。
砰的一声！
脑浆迸裂，死了一个痛痛快快。
“爹！！”
那男孩一声惊呼，只觉得两条腿软的就跟面条一样，实在是无力支撑，扑通一屁股就坐在了地上。
孙老爷子则趔趄后退，口中死命呼喊
“杀……杀人了！杀人啦！！！”
他也想将周青梅惊醒过来。
他们见识过江湖上的大侠，这些人在他们看来，虽然蠢得无可救药，但往往有着一副侠义心肠。
见到这样的场景，必然不会不管。
与此同时，门外这两位已经进了院子。
孙老爷子喊完了这一嗓子之后，只是眼前一个恍惚，就见原本刚刚跨入院中的两个人，竟然近在咫尺。
剧烈的惊吓之下，他猛地深吸了一口气，两眼一翻，脚尖一抻，竟然直接吓死了。
来的这两个，本来还打算分别动手，一人一个。
却没想到老头子这么不经事，说死就死。
抓孙老爷子的那之手，只好悻悻然的又收了回来。

另外一人则随手将那男孩给提了起来。
这一幕幕变化极快，等到那孩子反应过来的时候，已经被人抓着脑袋，提到了半空之中。
就听那人阴恻恻的开口
“周青梅，你身为珠玑阁的真传弟子，难道只有胆子藏在屋子里看戏？
“你若再不出来，我就将这个小子也给活活捏死！”
方书文和周青梅两个确实是在看戏，而且看的还挺开心。
孙家这一家子都没有好人，如今也算是遭了报应。
结果没想到这里面还有自己的事。
她和方书文两个对视一眼，就见方书文眉头微微一挑
“这两个人能不能看出来路？”
周青梅摇了摇头。
江湖上古怪的人，古怪的事，实在是太多了。
但像这两个这样特立独行的，却并不多见。
以他们的尊容，以及行事手段来看，没道理一点消息都传不出来。
可周青梅却从未听说过这么两个人。
方书文点了点头，推开窗户直接就钻了出去。
content_en:
The man with green face and red eyes was very close to the eldest brother of the Sun family when he spoke.
The breath fell on his face, and he felt a stench.
Rolling his eyes, he was so frightened that he couldn't control the person in his crotch and peed all over his pants.
The man who was holding him suddenly looked disgusted.
He pressed his left hand on the back of his head and hit the stone wall beside the door frame.
Bang!
His brain burst and he died painfully.
"Dad!!"
The boy exclaimed and felt that his legs were as soft as noodles. He was unable to support him and sat down on the ground with a plop.
Mr. Sun staggered back, shouting desperately
"Kill...kill people! Kill people!!!"
He also wanted to wake Zhou Qingmei up.
They have seen heroes in the world. In their opinion, although these people are hopelessly stupid, they often have a chivalrous heart.
Seeing such a scene, I will definitely not ignore it.
At the same time, the two people outside the door had entered the courtyard.
After Mr. Sun finished shouting this voice, he was just in a trance, and saw the two people who had just stepped into the hospital, actually very close at hand.
Severely frightened, he took a deep breath, rolled his eyes, stretched his toes, and was frightened to death.
The two people who came originally planned to attack separately, one person at a time.
But I didn't expect that the old man would be so careless and die as soon as he said so.
The hand that grabbed Mr. Sun had to be withdrawn angrily.
Another person casually picked up the boy.
This scene changed very quickly. By the time the child reacted, someone had already grabbed his head and lifted it into the air.
Just listen to the man's gloomy words
"Zhou Qingmei, as a true disciple of Zhuji Pavilion, do you only have the guts to hide in the room and watch the show?
“If you don’t come out, I will crush this kid to death too! "
Fang Shuwen and Zhou Qingmei were indeed watching the show, and they were quite happy.
There are no good people in the Sun family, and now they have received their retribution.
In the end, I didn’t expect that there was something of my own involved.
She and Fang Shuwen looked at each other, and Fang Shuwen raised his eyebrows slightly.
“Can these two people see a way out? "
Zhou Qingmei shook her head.
There are too many weird people and weird things in the world.
But people as unique as these two are rare.
Judging from their dignity and behavior, it makes no sense that no news could be spread.
But Zhou Qingmei had never heard of such two people.
Fang Shuwen nodded, opened the window and got out.
